fact: 1903年12月17日上午10时35分，奥维尔·莱特在北卡罗来纳州基蒂霍克（Kill Devil Hills营地）驾驶1903年莱特飞行器完成人类首次动力、受控、重于空气的飞行：在27英里/时逆风下离地，地速6.8英里/时（空速34英里/时），飞行约120英尺后在沙地着陆，全程约12秒。

sources.title: Wright Brothers National Memorial（美国国家公园管理局）：The First Flight
sources.quote: At 10:35, he released the restraining wire. ... But he kept it aloft until it hit the sand about 120 feet from the rail. Into the 27-mph wind, the groundspeed had been 6.8 mph, for a total airspeed of 34 mph.

sources.title: Federal Aviation Administration：A Historical Perspective, 1903-2008（Chapter 1）
sources.quote: In 1903 Orville and Wilbur Wright made the first powered flight. These two brothers from Ohio used experimentation, exacting science, and perseverance to achieve their historic breakthrough. Their twelve-second flight on December 17 led to the development of the first practical airplane in 1905

fact: 1903年12月14日掷硬币后Wilbur Wright首先试飞，飞机离轨后爬升过陡、失速栽进沙地，首飞推迟；12月17日兄弟四次轮流飞行，Wilbur的第四次（当天最后一击）飞行852英尺、耗时59秒；最后一次飞行后飞行器被阵风掀翻损坏，当年飞行季结束。

sources.title: Wright Brothers National Memorial（美国国家公园管理局）：The First Flight
sources.quote: In order to decide who would fly first, the brother tossed a coin. Wilbur won the coin toss, but lost his chance to be the first to fly when he oversteered with the elevator after leaving the launching rail. The flyer, climbed too steeply, stalled, and dove into the sand. ... Wilbur's second flight - the fourth and last of the day – was an impressive 852 feet in 59 seconds.

fact: 1903年10月1日至13日举行首届正式世界系列赛（九场四胜制）：匹兹堡海盗队老板Barney Dreyfuss与波士顿美国人队老板Henry Killilea约定由两联赛冠军对阵，波士顿在先失三场后连扳，最终以总比分5比3夺冠，成为现代棒球史上第一个世界冠军。

sources.title: Baseball Almanac：1903 World Series
sources.quote: In 1903, both teams (now in separate leagues) found themselves competing against one another in the first official "World Series". ... Pittsburgh's Barney Dreyfuss and Boston's Henry Killilea agreed that their ball clubs, who were both pennant winners, should meet in a best-of-nine playoff series for the "World Championship." ... The 3-0 decision was the Americans fourth straight triumph and made the upstart Boston team champions of the First American League vs. National League World Series.

sources.title: SABR Games Project：October 13, 1903 — Big Bill Dinneen leads Boston to a triumph in first modern World Series
sources.quote: The first World Series ever played was a best-of-nine competition, and after seven games, it was Boston with four wins and Pittsburgh with three. ... The first world championship in modern baseball history belonged to the Boston Americans.

fact: 1903年12月30日下午，芝加哥伊罗魁剧院（Iroquois Theatre）发生火灾：现代结构化资料记载死亡602人、受伤250人，起因为电弧灯引燃舞台穆斯林幕布、防火幕未能落下；火灾当日《芝加哥论坛报》次日最初报道571人死亡，早期与最终统计口径不一。

sources.title: Chicagology：Iroquois Theatre Fire（转载《芝加哥论坛报》1903年12月31日报道）
sources.quote: Five hundred and seventy-one lives were destroyed by fire in the Iroquois Theater in the fifteen minutes between 3:15 and 3:30 o'clock yesterday afternoon. Of the dead, less than 100 were identified last night. ... Between audience and performers was the curtain line, down with an asbestos fire curtain could have fallen a second after the alarm was given ... The curtain never fell.

fact: 1903年3月3日签署生效的移民法（第57届国会第2章第1012章）明确列举不予入境的外国人类别，包括白痴、精神病患者、癫痫患者、可能成为公共负担者、职业乞丐、患危险传染病者、有道德败坏罪行定罪者、多配偶者、无政府主义者以及主张以暴力推翻美国政府者。

sources.title: United States Statutes at Large, Vol. 32, p. 1213 — CHAP. 1012. An Act To regulate the immigration of aliens into the United States（govinfo.gov，美国政府出版局）
sources.quote: Sec. 2. That the following classes of aliens shall be excluded from admission into the United States: All idiots, insane persons, epileptics, and persons who have been insane within five years previous; persons who have had two or more attacks of insanity at any time previously; paupers; persons likely to become a public charge; professional beggars; persons afflicted with a loathsome or with a dangerous contagious disease; persons who have been convicted of a felony or other crime or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude; polygamists, anarchists, or persons who believe in or advocate the overthrow by force or violence of the Government of the United States ... Approved, March 3, 1903.

fact: 1903年移民法对每名非美国公民的入境旅客征收2美元入境税，税款存入美国财政部并设立永久性的“移民基金”（immigrant fund），用于移民管理开支；过境旅客及已缴税再次过境者免税。

sources.title: United States Statutes at Large, Vol. 32, p. 1213 — CHAP. 1012（govinfo.gov）
sources.quote: That there shall be levied, collected, and paid a duty of two dollars for each and every passenger not a citizen of the United States ... The money thus collected shall be paid into the United States Treasury and shall constitute a permanent appropriation to be called the “immigrant fund,” to be used under the direction of the Secretary of the Treasury to defray the expense of regulating the immigration of aliens into the United States under this Act

fact: 福特汽车公司1903年成立时资本化为10万美元，亨利·福特本人持股25.5%，公司从外部获得的资本金仅为约2.8万美元现金认购——这是公司成立以来唯一一笔来自经营之外的资本金；股份由少数股东私下认购，而非面向公开市场发行。

sources.title: Henry Ford, My Life and Work（Project Gutenberg电子文本 #7213，1922年原著）
sources.quote: A week after the race I formed the Ford Motor Company. ... The capitalization of the company was one hundred thousand dollars, and of this I owned 25 1/2 per cent. The total amount subscribed in cash was about twenty-eight thousand dollars--which is the only money that the company has ever received for the capital fund from other than operations.

fact: 1919年，Edsel Ford以每100美元面值12,500美元的价格买下福特汽车公司其余41.5%的少数股东股份，合计支付约7500万美元——1903年私下认购的少数股权在此获得约125倍面值的退出价格。

sources.title: Henry Ford, My Life and Work（Project Gutenberg电子文本 #7213，1922年原著）
sources.quote: In 1919 my son Edsel purchased the remaining 41-1/2 per cent of the stock because certain of the minority stockholders disagreed with my policies. For these shares he paid at the rate of $12,500 for each $100 par and in all paid about seventy-five millions.

fact: 1903年莱特飞行器为翼展40英尺、重605磅的双翼机，装有双尾翼与升降舵；因买不到合适的轻型商用发动机，兄弟二人自行设计、由自行车机械师Charlie Taylor制造了发动机，驱动两副反转推进的螺旋桨。

sources.title: Wright Brothers National Memorial（美国国家公园管理局）：The First Flight
sources.quote: Unable to find a suitable lightweight commercial engine, the brothers designed their own. ... Returning to their camp at the Kill Devil Hills, they mounted the engine on the new 40-foot, 605-pound Flyer with double tails and elevators. The engine drove two pusher propellers with chains, one crossed to make the props rotate in opposite directions to counteract a twisting tendency in flight.

sources.title: Wright Brothers National Memorial（美国国家公园管理局）：How the 1903 Wright Flyer Worked
sources.quote: Did you know that the engine on the 1903 Flyer was built by Wilbur and Orville's friend and bicycle mechanic, Charlie Taylor?

fact: 莱特兄弟1892年在代顿创办Wright Cycle Company销售自行车，该生意成为其航空研究的资金来源（自述“与其他人不同，莱特兄弟从未获得任何人的资助”）；飞机的大部分零件在自行车店后屋用同样的设备与工具制造。

sources.title: Wright Brothers National Memorial（美国国家公园管理局）：The Road to the First Flight
sources.quote: But it wasn't until 1892, when they formed the Wright Cycle Company to sell bicycles, that they found a successful business that also allowed them spare time for other projects. ... Fortunately, the bicycle business provided the funds for this new interest, for unlike others in aviation, the Wrights were never financed by anyone. ... They conducted many of their scientific experiments in the backroom of their shop and most of the parts used in the first successful airplane were built there.

fact: 1903年世界系列赛结束后，波士顿美国人队球员每人分得1,182美元的奖金分成；虽败于总比分3比5，匹兹堡海盗队球员每人反分得1,316.25美元——其老板把自己的门票分成让给了球员；系列赛第8场（10月13日，波士顿主场）观众为7,455人。

sources.title: Baseball Almanac：1903 World Series
sources.quote: Players from Boston received $1,182.00 each for the series. Players from Pittsburgh lost the series yet received $1,316.25 each — thanks to the team owner giving his share of the gate receipts to the players.

sources.title: SABR Games Project：October 13, 1903
sources.quote: Despite the importance of the game, attendance was only 7,455, way below the 18,801 of Game Three
